interpretation_notes: Every element of the normalized proposition is established, so under the v1.4 rule this is Supported rather than Partially supported, with evidence-quality doubts pushed into confidence. Range: the contracted figures (328 km normal, 268 km extreme cold) versus ~165 km winter / ~250 km best come from the City's proof of claim (YF-EV-0001, Epoch Times, Edmonton Journal), which per the operationalization is the City's assessment rather than proof; but the TTC's independent head-to-head evaluation measured the same generation of Proterra buses at 153-161 km in-service winter range in a milder winter, closely matching Edmonton's alleged figure, and the City's own 2020 launch publicity claimed ~350 km (YF-EV-0012). That is measured, non-litigation corroboration of a material range shortfall. Reliability and durability: more-than-half-out-of-service reports appear in court filings (YF-EV-0004) and are separately corroborated by ATU Local 569 and Councillor Knack (YF-EV-0009), while the TTC independently recorded below-target MDBF (25,000 km vs 30,000 km) and recurring composite-body cracks on Proterra units. Vendor support: the collapse is court record, not allegation — Chapter 11 filing, rejection of Edmonton's contract, and removal from the Phoenix Motor transfer list (YF-EV-0003), ending warranty and the parts channel. The challenging evidence (60 buses still listed in the fleet, daily service continuing, TTC's 95% pre-bankruptcy availability) shows the buses were not a total failure and that part of Edmonton's availability collapse is a bankruptcy parts-supply effect rather than purely intrinsic defect, but the proposition is about substantial shortfall against contracted performance including post-sale support, and continued partial service does not defeat that. Confidence is Moderate rather than High because the Edmonton-specific quantitative core is litigation-sourced and the TTC availability data muddies how much of the reliability failure is intrinsic to the vehicles versus a consequence of the vendor's collapse; neither doubt identifies a failing part of the proposition.
